# Replay returns the accepted workflow before any new acceptance: after a
# lost response, after completion, and after a restart of the same daemon
# and state. No node runs twice.
private-workdir
skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
skygo auth principal add alice --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice.token --expires-in 24h
server start
graph-file chain.tmpl chain.yaml

# The daemon accepts the workflow, but the client loses the response.
drop-response /skygo.v1.WorkflowService/SubmitWorkflow
! skygo --endpoint $PROXY --token-file alice.token --json workflow run -f chain.yaml --request-id chain
stderr '^request-id: chain\n'
! stdout .
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow run -f chain.yaml --request-id chain
json-field id WF
await-workflow alice.token $WF b succeeded
cp stdout done.json
event-count 2
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow run -f chain.yaml --request-id chain
cmp stdout done.json
calls WorkflowService/SubmitWorkflow 3
calls job-submissions 0
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow list
stdout '"id": *"'$WF'"'
! json-field workflows.1.id EXTRA

# A different graph cannot reuse the request ID.
graph-file changed.tmpl changed.yaml
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f changed.yaml --request-id chain
stderr 'already_exists'
event-count 2

# The same daemon and state after a restart.
server stop
! stderr .
server start
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow get $WF
cmp stdout done.json
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow run -f chain.yaml --request-id chain
cmp stdout done.json
json-field nodes.1.job_id BJOB
skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $BJOB
stdout '^node b\n$'
event-count 2
calls job-submissions 0
server stop
! stderr .

-- chain.tmpl --
nodes:
- name: a
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: succeed, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: a}
- name: b
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: succeed, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: b, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_AFTER: a}
  depends_on: [a]
-- changed.tmpl --
nodes:
- name: a
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: succeed, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: a}
- name: b
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: succeed, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: changed, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_AFTER: a}
  depends_on: [a]
